title: anisantha fasciculata subsp. delilei
intro: Anisantha fasciculata subsp. delilei, commonly known as Spike Beard-grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. Spike Beard-grass is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing swelling and protecting the body from oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Spike Beard-grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antimicrobial, and anti-diarrheal properties.
